records.key: Detection reads the image as drawn (normalized).
records.source: Detection reads the image as drawn (normalized).
records.translation: A detecção usa a imagem como é exibida (normalizada).

records.key: Detection reads the image as loaded.
records.source: Detection reads the image as loaded.
records.translation: A detecção usa a imagem como foi carregada.

records.key: Off: Otsu, Cellpose and the magnifier read the image as it was loaded (inverted if Invert is on), and Lower % / Upper % only change how it is drawn. On: they read it stretched between Lower % and Upper %, exactly as drawn, and the intensity in the top-left corner shows that stretched value. What is saved is never changed.
records.source: Off: Otsu, Cellpose and the magnifier read the image as it was loaded (inverted if Invert is on), and Lower % / Upper % only change how it is drawn. On: they read it stretched between Lower % and Upper %, exactly as drawn, and the intensity in the top-left corner shows that stretched value. What is saved is never changed.
records.translation: Desativado: Otsu, Cellpose e a lupa usam a imagem como foi carregada (invertida se Inverter estiver ativado), e % inferior / % superior alteram apenas a exibição. Ativado: usam a imagem com as intensidades expandidas entre % inferior e % superior, exatamente como é exibida, e a intensidade no canto superior esquerdo mostra esse valor expandido. Os dados salvos nunca são alterados.
